Riley Securities analyst Craig Ellis downgraded Rigetti to Neutral from Buy and raised his price target on the stock to $42 from $35 in a note Monday.  Barron’s reported in August that Rigetti had been selected for a $5.8 million Air Force contract, which the company announced a month later along with two purchase orders for a combined $5.7 million on Sept. 30.
